description: Apply available OS package updates (all, security-only, or a specific set of patch_ids) on a node, optionally reboot according to the reboot policy, then refresh the patchbot posture. The console reads the resulting posture via the patchbot fact on the next run.

console_url.description: Console base URL (server-injected; unused by the patch itself).

ingest_token.description: Server-injected; unused by the patch itself.

security_only.description: Apply only security updates when true; otherwise apply all available updates. Ignored when patch_ids is set.

patch_ids.description: Install only these specific patch/package ids, as reported in the patchbot fact's packages[] array. Takes priority over security_only when set. Only packages that are already installed are upgraded; none is newly installed. Must match [A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9._:+-]*[A-Za-z0-9._:+])? -- rejected otherwise, since these are used unquoted on a package-manager command line running as root: a leading '-' or embedded whitespace would be read as a flag, and a trailing '-' is apt's remove syntax (apt-get install foo- removes foo).

reboot.description: Reboot policy. never: do not reboot. if-needed: reboot only when the node reports a reboot is required; when it cannot tell, do not reboot. always: reboot every patched node. The legacy Boolean is still accepted (true means if-needed, false means never).
